title: Manual Drive Train and Axles
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Manual Drive Train and Axles Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the manual transmission and drive axle rebuilding industry.
Demonstrate their ability to assess, evaluate and solve problems common to manual transmission and drive axle repair in the automotive, industrial, and agricultural industries.

Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the core material of manual transmission and drive axle rebuilding and repair required for transfer to a four year university or certification in the department programs.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (AUTOB30); AUTOB30 is treated as the closed-list course AUTO B30.
AUTOB11 and AUTOB48 are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.
The certificate total of 12 units is printed as '(Total 12)' above the nested 'Complete all of the following' headings; no separate block total is printed.

Careers 'Transportation Industry' and 'Automotive Industry' come from the description's 'careers in' sentence; the rest come from the Career Opportunities heading. Workplaces such as performance shops and dealerships are not recorded as careers.
The award level in the request (8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units) is consistent with the 12-unit total.
